changelog:
Initial release with efficient short video reverse engineering workflow.

- Automatically extracts keyframes, performs speech-to-text transcription, visual analysis, and generates a structured HTML report (in Chinese).
- Includes compliance checking for copyright and sensitive content, with risk handling suggestions.
- Integrates an optimized processing flow for batch or single video analysis; one-click extraction consolidates multiple steps into a single script call.
- Visual analysis uses a single contact sheet image for efficiency; report embeds visual previews and detailed breakdowns.
- Generates practical AI prompts for video regeneration, complete with time-aligned subtitles, 10-second adaptation strategies, and character consistency guarantees.
- Separates reference images as external files for easier handling; no more large, base64-embedded images within reports.
- Outputs: well-organized HTML report and character reference images, ready for use on platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, and WeChat Channels.
summary: 用于对短视频进行反向工程分析：自动提取关键帧、语音转文字、逐帧视觉分析，并生成包含 AI 提示词（仅中文）、台词时间轴、制作建议的 HTML 分析报告。含合规检查（侵权/违规内容排查）和 10 秒适配方案。适用于抖音/快手/视频号等短视频的内容拆解与二次创作。
